subject: Werner Q2 2026 GAAP / adjusted margin reconciliation
claim: Werner reported Q2 2026 GAAP operating margin of 1.8% versus 8.8%, while its company-reported non-GAAP adjusted operating margin rose to 3.0% from 2.2%, a 0.8pp YoY increase. Management principally attributed the GAAP operating-income decline to $53.6m of prior-year favorable liability reversals not recurring. These are company disclosures, not an independent causal estimate.
excerpt: Segment cross-check: adjusted TTS operating income rose to $32.3m from $12.8m; adjusted Logistics operating income fell to a $2.7m loss from $5.9m income. FirstFleet was acquired in January 2026. GAAP and non-GAAP peer margins are not interchangeable; retain the all-GAAP main comparison and do not substitute only Werner's adjusted result.
location: July 28, 2026 earnings release: consolidated results; TTS and Logistics sections; GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation

source.title: Werner Q2 2026 results and GAAP / non-GAAP reconciliation

confidenceRationale: Reported values and management explanation checked against the company's dated release and reconciliation. Adjusted definitions and acquisition mix require separate peer review; source matching does not validate a causal explanation.

stanceReasons.H4: Reported margin pressure is not itself fuel attribution; the issuer identifies a prior-year liability-reversal effect.
stanceReasons.H5: Company-specific reconciliation challenges interpreting the negative GAAP peer mean as broad operating-leverage falsification.
